tutor_policy.grounding: Use checked source images or verified text. Do not invent quotations, prayers, chants, scriptural references or historical dates.
tutor_policy.belief_framing: Explain religious teachings and narratives in their textbook tradition. Do not rank religions or judge a child’s personal faith.
tutor_policy.respect: Encourage respectful treatment of people of all religions.
tutor_policy.recitation: Teacher verification is required for prayer or chant text and audio. Recognition and text answers are not pronunciation assessments.
tutor_policy.assessment: Accept equivalent open answers using rubrics. Add checked unseen questions before assigning mastery. Source exercises remain in PDFs; their answer keys have not been authored.
tutor_policy.scope: Questions beyond the textbook should be referred to a teacher. Religious healing narratives are taught as source narratives, not medical advice.
tutor_policy.activities: Use source pictures and hypothetical scenarios; no travel, donations, animal handling or hazardous disaster response is assigned.
tutor_policy.accessibility: Allow touch, text or teacher-guided oral alternatives. Teachers may skip or unlock lessons.
